message.content:
This vertical rectangular magazine cover features a close-up portrait of a light-skinned man with dark, short-cropped hair. His face dominates the frame, appearing from the mid-forehead down to the upper jaw. One side of his face is covered in dark green and black mottled paint, resembling military camouflage, which obscures the skin texture and part of his right eye. The other side shows his natural skin tone with visible pores and wrinkles. His eyes are dark; the eye on the painted side appears bloodshot.

Large white capital letters reading "TEMPO" are superimposed across the top of his head. Below this, smaller text reads "EDISI 28 OKTOBER-3 NOVEMBER 2013". At the top left, yellow and white text states "OUTLOOK EKONOMI 2014 ANTARA KRISIS & HANTU PEMILU". In the bottom right corner, large white text reads "PALAGAN TERAKHIR PRABOWO". The bottom left contains a barcode, the price "RP 33.000", a website URL, and serial numbers. A thin red border frames the left and bottom edges. The background behind the man is a neutral, light gray.
